dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Did you have a good time with Minnie? Is it about time to head back?

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Yes, yes! We had so much fun!

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Also, I took a closer look at the drawings Minnie gave me...

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: And in quite a few of them I saw... the idol of Mondstadt? Miss Barbara of the Church of Favonius is a really good dancer!

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Didn't Mualani say she wanted another dance party at the resort? She even said that she wanted to invite dance experts from other nations this time...

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Maybe Mualani would be interested in inviting Miss Barbara?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Sounds like an idea. I'll show these drawings to Mualani and see what she says...
